Test whether a point is above or below a plane

**Panel:** Comma → Point · **Nickname:** `Above`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Points | `Pt` | Point | List |  | Points for plane relation test |
| Plane | `Pl` | Plane | Item | `Plane.WorldXY` | Reference plane |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Boolean Relation | `RB` | Boolean | List | Boolean relation (above or coincident = true, below = false) |
| Integer Relation | `Ri` | Integer | List | Integer relation (above = 1, coincident = 0, below = -1) |
